description: Screen supplied applicant, property, residence, review-year and VA-related answers for missing information before a program requirements review. Uses the same contract as audit_veteran_shield. No default applicant or jurisdiction, eligibility decision, tax estimate, provider verification, document generation or filing.

address.description: Legacy alias for property_address; not a parcel lookup.

county_name.description: Reported county. No county is inferred from an address.

has_remarried.description: Reported surviving-spouse remarriage status. Omit when unknown.

has_va_dic_award.description: Reported VA survivor benefit award status. Omit when unknown.

honorable_discharge.description: Legacy alias for is_honorable_discharge. Conflicting values remain unknown.

is_honorable_discharge.description: Reported honorable discharge status; no document verification is performed.

is_permanent_and_total.description: Reported permanent-and-total status, separate from rating. Omit when unknown.

is_primary_residence.description: Whether this property is the applicant's primary residence for the requested review year. Omit when unknown.

is_surviving_spouse.description: Whether the applicant is a surviving spouse. This does not establish DIC, remarriage status or eligibility.

ownership_relationship.description: Reported relationship to this property; does not establish ownership or delegated authority.

parcel_id.description: Explicit county parcel or property account identifier.

property_address.description: Explicit property street address. Supply the parcel or account identifier separately.

rating_percentage.description: Legacy alias for va_disability_percentage. Conflicting values remain unknown.

review_year.description: Requested review year, separate from any county source or bill year.

state_code.description: Reported two-letter state code; no default jurisdiction.

va_disability_percentage.description: Reported VA disability rating. A 100% rating alone does not establish permanent-and-total status.

veteran_name.description: Applicant name supplied for this review; never inferred from an account or VA record.

name: check_veteran_relief
